Package com.salesforce.multicloudj.docstore.ali

Class AliDocumentIterator

java.lang.Object
com.salesforce.multicloudj.docstore.ali.AliDocumentIterator
All Implemented Interfaces:
DocumentIterator
public class AliDocumentIterator extends Object implements DocumentIterator
DocumentIterator backed by the Tablestore native GetRange API (see QueryRunner).

Drives cursor-based pagination: it fetches pages by following the server's nextStartPrimaryKey, and the caller-facing getPaginationToken() returns the primary key of the LAST row handed out via next(com.salesforce.multicloudj.docstore.driver.Document). That is a positional bookmark a caller can persist and use to resume in a later, separate query.

Resuming: the driver sets inclusiveStartPrimaryKey to the token's key. Because Tablestore's range start is inclusive, the row equal to the resume key (the last one the previous call already returned) is re-read and must be skipped; resumeAfterKey handles that.

Loop-accumulate: when a column filter is present, GetRange's limit caps rows SCANNED, not RETURNED, so a page may yield fewer matches than requested (or none) while still returning a cursor. hasNext() therefore keeps fetching until a row is available or the range is exhausted.

Offset: GetRange has no native offset, so a caller-supplied offset is simulated by skipping that many matching rows (fetching pages as needed) before the first row is returned. Offset and a resume token are mutually exclusive at the query layer, so at most one applies.
